name: canonical-reconcile
why: The settled boundary: wrap-up disclaims this as reflect on its own. The single case that has to pass.

name: bare-reflect
why: The phrasing the skill is named for, with session scope but no closeout verbs attached.

name: play-it-back
query: repeat back to me everything you think you learned today so I can confirm it
why: Step 3's approval gate stated in the user's own words. No use of reflect or reconcile, so this checks the trigger reads the procedure rather than the label.

name: stale-claim-hunt
query: we renamed that flag, go find everywhere the docs and comments still call it the old thing
why: Step 2B: a session change made written statements false, across docs, comments and configs. Reconciliation intent with no reflection vocabulary at all.

name: worth-saving-to-memory
query: is there anything from today worth saving to memory
why: Durable-knowledge promotion, which is reflect's half of the closeout and never notes'. Includes the routing question of whether it is a memory at all.

name: correct-a-wrong-belief
query: that assumption you've been working from is wrong, make sure nothing we've written still says it
why: A correction that has to propagate everywhere it was recorded, including memory. The grep-every-site half of the sweep.

name: close-out-the-session
why: wrap-up. The head-to-head case: reflect's own description still claims this phrase, and the settled boundary gives whole-session closeout to wrap-up. Firing here is the contested false positive.

name: session-closeout-chain
query: reflect, notes, then push it all up
why: wrap-up. The word reflect appears, but three chain verbs together is the closeout orchestrator, which runs this skill as its first gate.

name: docs-sweep
query: update the docs with what we did
why: notes. Session work into the living docs is the sweep reflect deliberately hands off rather than performing.

name: take-notes
why: notes. Same end-of-session timing, but the object is the repo's documentation, not memory or stale claims.

name: orientation
why: hi. Session-start orientation reads state; reflect reconciles it at the end and writes.

name: memory-lookup
query: search your memory for what we know about the embedding model
why: mem-search. A read of existing memory, with nothing new to promote and no claim to correct.

name: generic-thinking
query: think carefully about how to design this API before you write anything
why: No skill. Reflection in the everyday sense, with no session to reconcile. Guards against the trigger keying on the word think or reflect.

name: commit-in-progress-work
query: commit what we have so far so I don't lose it
why: A plain commit. One verb, mid-session, and reflect does not commit or push.
